note: Unchanged since last audit (ab07199 .. 031ffda touches only BatchNFTMinter.sol). Profiled lightly as interaction context for BatchNFTMinter. Masterchef-style APY-driven phUSD reward pool for ERC1155 NFT stakes; full spec/invariants in submodule CLAUDE.md.

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoopsNote: No loops over user-controlled arrays; per-user O(1) accounting (accRewardPerShare / rewardDebt masterchef pattern).
verifiedProperties.checkedArithmeticNote: ^0.8.20; uses OZ Math.mulDiv with floor rounding (conservative for a reward contract).
verifiedProperties.reentrancyGuardedNote: Every external user entry point uses nonReentrant. Contrast with BatchNFTMinter which uses none.
verifiedProperties.accessControlNote: All setters onlyOwner; pause/unpause onlyPauser; stake/unstake/claim permissionless+whenNotPaused; emergencyWithdraw permissionless and callable while paused.
verifiedProperties.initializerNote: Non-upgradeable; constructor sets immutable stakedToken, rewardToken, initialOwner.

localFindingsNote: No new local findings; contract unchanged since last audit and prior local concerns reconciled in earlier runs. Solvency invariant (balance == rewardBudget + committedDebt) and emergencyWithdraw escape hatch documented in submodule CLAUDE.md.

externalEntryPoints.note: Callable while paused; forfeits pending reward; skips _syncBudget/_updatePool.

externalCalls.notes: Realises mint-debt as phUSD into this contract. Rotatable live (no empty-pool guard).
Drives latestPrice for APY-based reward rate. Cast of deployed NFTMinterV2.

sharedDependenciesWithBatchNFTMinter: Both consume yield-claim-nft V2 dispatcher config (NFTStaker via INFTSupply.configs for pricing; BatchNFTMinter via INFTMinterV2.configs + dispatcher.primeToken).
Both integrate the pauser submodule (IPausable) with the same onlyPauser + OZ Pausable hybrid pattern.
NFTStaker.dispatcherIndex and BatchNFTMinter.dispatcherIndex are INDEPENDENT storage on separate contracts; no shared state.
